name: A nudge that helps the Planner
purpose: A nudge is infrequent and moves the Planner toward the longer-term outcome.
record: Twenty-four invented cases with neutral objectives (evaluation/guidance/build_cases.py), each tagged with the clause of the decision rule it exercises (the rule Quest AI Runner's measured long-term guidance states: speak only when it fits, one grounded sentence, never when urgent, upset, unrelated, asked to stop or raised lately). Twelve nudge cases and twelve restraint cases; one number: the share answered correctly, which is the mean of the nudge and restraint pass rates. Balanced with cost and time by [balance.guidance], weights and budgets fixed before any arm was scored. Cheap offline stage only; no model call.
disadvantages: Invented cases written from one system's stated rule, so a pass shows the rule is carried out, not that nudges help people. The grounding check is by code (target and reading present, one sentence, no dash); whether a person feels nagged, and a model-call arm that writes the sentence, have no stage yet.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run guidance --impl rule_gate; esoi run guidance --impl overlap_only; esoi run guidance --impl always_nudge
